name: Belmond Copacabana Palace
insider_take: This Art Deco masterpiece has been the crown jewel of Copacabana Beach since 1923, where Hollywood legends and royalty have made unforgettable memories against Rio's most iconic backdrop.
whats_special: The palace sits directly on world-famous Copacabana Beach and features the only hotel pool in Rio with direct beach access. Its stunning Art Deco architecture has remained virtually unchanged since opening, and the hotel has hosted everyone from Walt Disney to Princess Diana. The property's Cipriani restaurant is helmed by a Michelin-starred chef, making it a culinary destination in its own right.
pro_tip: Book a poolside table at the hotel's famous Saturday feijoada lunch - it's where Rio's elite gather for the city's best traditional Brazilian feast while watching the beach scene unfold.
dont_miss: The legendary New Year's Eve celebration on Copacabana Beach happens right outside your door - over 2 million people gather for the world's largest beach party. During Carnival, the hotel becomes the unofficial headquarters for Rio's most exclusive parties, and the rooftop offers unparalleled views of Christ the Redeemer statue and Sugarloaf Mountain.
pros: Iconic beachfront location directly on Copacabana Beach
Historic Art Deco palace with legendary glamour and heritage
cons: Busy beachfront location can be crowded during peak times
